pages.text: [#](53341a)An infernal cooking-working that turns dropped raw food into cooked meals all at once.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Broiling

pages.text: [#](53341a)Efficient, dramatic, and never entirely gentle — for when a camp of meat needs preparing faster than any oven.[#]()
[#](53341a)Started from a small infernal circle with **Sugar**.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)The ordinary branch needs **Wood Ash** and **Coal** (1000 power); the hotter branch needs **Wood Ash**, **Blaze Powder**, and a **Charged Attuned Stone**.[#]()
[#](53341a)It cooks every raw food in reach. The hotter branch is harsher — some offerings return as **Charcoal** instead of supper.[#]()
